title: DNS over QUIC RFC 9250 Stream Lifecycle Work Item
summary: Add the minimal DoQ query/response stream lifecycle over the existing QUIC stream facade.
planned_changes:
- Add `DoqClient` for one query per client-initiated bidirectional stream.
- Set the DNS Message ID field to zero before sending a query over DoQ.
- Add `DoqServer` and `IDoqQueryHandler` for accepting query streams and writing responses on the same stream.
- Add shared stream helpers for length-prefixed DoQ reads and writes with FIN.
- Add loopback tests that prove one-stream-per-query, same-stream responses, and concurrent queries on one connection.
verification_plan: Run the focused DoQ stream lifecycle tests, the RFC 9250 requirement-home tests, core SpecTrace JSON validation, and diff hygiene.
out_of_scope: STOP_SENDING, RESET_STREAM, cancellation limits, dangling stream limits, and excessive load policy.
Gateway DNS Message ID generation when forwarding from DoQ to non-DoQ transports.
completion_notes: The DoQ adapter can now perform minimal query/response transactions over real QUIC streams, while later RFC 9250 slices retain ownership of cancellation, privacy, transfer, and interop behavior.
